# Cold Clear upstream snapshot

Repository: https://github.com/MinusKelvin/cold-clear

Revision: `279edd7c3177ff8077f6a930193397814b281f27` (`master` at download).

Retrieved on 2026-10-07 from
`https://codeload.github.com/MinusKelvin/cold-clear/tar.gz/279edd7c3177ff8077f6a930193397814b281f27`.

The files in this directory, except this provenance file, are the unmodified
upstream archive. They are reference sources and are not compiled by CMake.
The original MPL-2.0 license is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The C++ adaptation is in `src/bot/coldclear/` and `src/bot/bot_coldclear.cpp`.
Its MPL-2.0 source headers identify the upstream origin. See
`docs/BOT_COLDCLEAR.md` for the translation map and deliberate host adaptations.
